summary: Iteration 14 - verified Balance Stock formula, Extra Stock backend + UI, and Company Balance PENDING ONLY / SHOWING ALL toggle. Backend: 91/91 pytest passing (added 21 new tests in test_extra_stock.py, single-threaded run 110s). Frontend: /extra-stock loads via rail-stock -> tab-extra-stock, stat strip + rows + xlsx/pdf downloads + search + refresh all work; /company-balance defaults to PENDING ONLY hiding fully-arrived rows, toggle flips to SHOWING ALL and back, typing into a visible pending row edits the CORRECT underlying record (verified via API) and persists after reload, hidden fully-arrived row is NOT touched, Ctrl+Z (undo) does NOT wipe hidden fully-arrived rows. Regression: /, /orders, /stock, /shop-sale, /company-order, /summary, /balance all load 200.

backend_pytest.controlled_example_proven: stock=20 + pending(sent 30 - arrived 10)=20 - ordered=12 - shop_sold=3 => balance = 25 (asserted exactly)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py balance_stock() ordering: `entry()` is called for stock first, then orders, but pending/shop_sold aggregation uses _norm(...) which is UPPER while entry() key uses item.strip().upper() - identical, OK. Verified with mixed-case items in the formula test.

extra_stock_rows() ignores rows where item is blank (correct); arrived-only rows with no matching sent still surface as extra (arrived_qty - 0 > 0). This matches the spec 'Arrived - Sent per Group+Item+Shade where positive'. Consider documenting the arrived-only-with-empty-sent case in the page subtitle.

LineSheet.jsx `visible` slice preserves the original `idx` per row so hidden rows keep their absolute position; setCell/deleteRow/paste all use that idx. Empirically verified: editing in pending-only view edited the right record and Ctrl+Z undo did not remove the hidden fully-arrived row.

CompanyBalanceOrder.jsx recomputes `map` on every render (Object.fromEntries over ~685 rows) and the memoized `visibleFilter` depends on `map` via eslint-disable — safe today because `balance` state change triggers re-render, but any future change to `map` construction must keep this invariant.

ExtraStock.jsx uses `${r.group}-${r.item}-${r.shade}` as React key. Fine given the endpoint dedupes by that key; still, if two rows collide on a rarely-blank shade the console will warn. Consider joining with a delimiter that can't appear in item (e.g. `\u0001`).
seed_data_creation: Three transient QA_UI_ line-sheet rows were created via API during UI testing (QA_UI_EXTRA sent+arrived, QA_UI_ARRIVED_FULL sent+arrived, QA_UI_PENDING sent) and deleted at teardown (CLEANUP: 5). The autouse fixture in test_extra_stock.py also purges any QA_XS_ leftovers.
